property_summary: For any admissible input, sendMoney never reverts even when the target refuses the funds (the low-level call's failure is ignored), whereas the mutant's transfer makes sendMoney revert for some target/amount, so ok must always be true on the reference and is false on the bug for a reverting recipient.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with transfer, which forwards no data and reverts on failure (e.g., on gas-limited fallbacks).
